broken.label: a thing is already broken (from the start of the scene)

cues.text: Peddy, let us ride our motorcycle past the car across the town!
Hold on tight as we speed along!
Look, the rail_track is broken right here!
Oh no, a train is coming this way fast!
Quick, we must weld the track before it arrives!
Look, the train crossed safely over our fixed rail_track!
The passengers are safe and cheering for us!
